patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Pipedrive documents a broader use-case set; Capsule is narrower/specialist.

General-purpose vs specialist. Choose Capsule only if your buying job matches “Simple small-business CRM for contacts, sales pipelines, tasks, and lightweight automation” rather than Pipedrive's shape. Choose Pipedrive only if your buying job matches “Pipeline-first sales CRM for visual deal management, activity-based selling, and growing s” rather than Capsule's shape. Workflow advantage: Capsule leans contact-management, account-management; Pipedrive leans lead-management, sales-automation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Pipedrive documents a broader use-case set; Capsule is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Capsule is Simple small-business CRM for contacts, sales pipelines, tasks, and lightweight automation without enterprise complexity.; Pipedrive is Pipeline-first sales CRM for visual deal management, activity-based selling, and growing sales teams..
- Workflow coverage skew: Capsule-leaning contact-management, account-management vs Pipedrive-leaning lead-management, sales-automation, email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Capsule — Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.; Pipedrive — Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher..

Limitations — Capsule: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.; Workflow automations and advanced reporting start at Growth; enrichment at Advanced.; Pipedrive: Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher.; Campaigns and Web Visitors remain paid add-ons on all plans; LeadBooster/Projects/Smart Docs are add-ons below Premium..

Poor-fit cases: Capsule is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier. · Pipedrive is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher. · Avoid Capsule if you actually need Pipedrive's motion (Pipeline-first sales CRM for visual deal management, activity-based selling, and)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
